notes: SSC CGL 2024 Tier I (CBE) was conducted between 09-Sep-2024 and 26-Sep-2024. Exam days and per-day shifts documented by Oliveboard's Tier I PYP page (https://www.oliveboard.in/blog/ssc-cgl-tier-1-pyps/): 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18, 19, 23, 24, 25 and 26-Sep-2024 with Shifts 1-3 each (36 shifts total - matching Adda247's CGL PYP page statement of '36 Shifts' for the series). Oliveboard's per-shift PDFs are served through a form-gated 'free PYP kit' page; no 4th shift is listed for any date. No verified Tier I question-paper files have been collected for this year in this repository.
